mixed: Per gas, largest actual Train Batch share >=0.50 -> spread; otherwise recent. Threshold fixed before new evaluation, no gas identity or Batch9/10 score rule.
coverage: For q gas rows over m observed Train batches, reserve min(cell_capacity,max(1,floor(q/(2m)))) in every observed cell, then fill remaining budget greedily from newest batches. No nonexistent cells.
sampling: Same SeedSequence(seed,gas,Batch) prefixes as stage12; fixed row order.
primary: Mean of3 Fold Macro F1, then mean across5 seeds; SD across seed means(ddof1).
balance: Mean Macro F1 delta vs spread_mid >=0.005; Toluene/Acetaldehyde mean Recall delta >-0.05; each of other4 gas mean Recall delta >-0.10; all Fold mean deltas >=0 (tolerance1e-12), >=2 strictly positive; all5 seed equal-Fold mean deltas >0. Identical subsets count as neutral, never artificially perturbed. Rules descriptive, not safety/significance standards.
expansion: Only prespecified mixed/coverage are eligible for1689: 843 mean Macro delta>=0.005, all Recall guards, >=2 positive Fold means and >=4 positive seed means. At most2 targets, all3Folds/all5seeds. Always reuse spread_max reference. Expanded strategies are additionally judged against equal-size spread_max; same Validation reused, not independent. No after-result substitution.
conclusion: A if a new strategy satisfies full balance; B if Macro gain>=0.005 or any mean gas Recall gain>=0.02 exists but loss/inconsistency remains; otherwise C. No official model replacement or seed winner.
reuse: Stage12 stored models for exact matching rows/order,settings,seed. All new fits only under models/gas_specific_temporal_balancing.
future: After all historical and expansion findings are frozen, evaluate only four843 strategies x5seeds (20 logical models), Batch9/10 and pooled. No expansion models in future evaluation, no reselection, new independent Test absent.
limitations: Historical windows and seeds overlap; five seeds quantify subset randomness, not independent temporal replication. Research motivated by already seen9/10; no future-independent or fully causal claim.
